description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom change set named MigrateAllergiesChangeSet used to migrate allergy data between tables in the OpenMRS system. It implements the CustomTaskChange interface and contains logic to move unvoided allergy records from legacy active lists to new allergy-related tables, including handling of allergy severities and related concepts.
